sentences.text: ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. TRS Sodha For Respondent(s) : Mr. Hanuman Prajapati, PP with  Mr. Ravindra Singh Bhati  Mr. B.S. Mertia, for complainant.
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANEESH SHARMA Order 01/04/2026 1.

The instant anticipatory bail application has been filed under Section 482 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (B.N.S.S.) by the petitioners apprehending their arrest in connection with FIR No.132/2021, Police Station Siwana, District Balotra for the offences under Sections 420, 467,
468, 471, 447 and 120-B of IPC, 1860.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are the Ward Members of Gram Panchayat, Mokalsar and that only the signatures and thumb impression of the Ward members were affixed on the lease deed and they are not beneficiaries of the same in any manner.

He further submits that (Uploaded on 02/04/2026 at 03:10:51 PM) [2026:RJ-JD:14990] (2 of 3)
[CRLMB-15408/2025] they have not been named in the FIR and there are no specific allegations of forgery against them.

He further submits that petitioner No.1-Dhepidevi and No.2-Hemlata are ladies aged 79 and 65 years old, respectively, and petitioner No.3-Gomaram, is also aged about 75 years old, and that they have already joined the investigation as per the directions given by this Court, therefore, no useful purpose would be served by sending the petitioners behind bars or for custodial interrogation; he therefore, prays that the petitioners may kindly be released on anticipatory bail.

3. Learned Public Prosecutor and counsel for the complainant have vehemently opposed the present bail application and pray for dismissal of the same.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the impugned order.
5.

Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case and upon a consideration of the arguments advanced at Bar, particularly the fact that the petitioner No.1-Dhepidevi and No.2- Hemlata are old aged ladies and petitioner No.3-Gomaram, is also aged about 75 years old, and that they have already joined the investigation as per the directions given by this Court, without expressing any opinion on the merits or demerits of the case, is of the opinion that it is a fit case for grant of anticipatory bail to the petitioner under Section 482 BNSS.
6.

Accordingly, the anticipatory bail application is allowed and it is directed that in the event of arrest of petitioners (1) Dhepidevi W/o Kesharam, (2) Hemlata W/o Tejraj & (3) Gomaram S/o Rugharam, in connection with FIR No.132/2021, Police (Uploaded on 02/04/2026 at 03:10:51 PM)
